from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
root=Path(sys.argv[1]);report=json.loads(Path(sys.argv[2]).read_bytes())
p=report["transformation"];h=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest();files={}
for f in p["files"]:
    b=(root/f["path"]).read_bytes();assert h(b)==f["after"]["sha256"]
    assert b==Path(f["after"]["frozen_path"]).read_bytes();files[f["path"]]=b
for s in reversed(p["seams"]):
    b=files[s["path"]];v=s["insert_utf8_lf"].encode();at=s["offset"]
    assert h(b)==s["after_step_sha256"] and h(v)==s["insert_sha256"]
    assert b[at:at+len(v)]==v;b=b[:at]+b[at+len(v):]
    assert h(b)==s["before_step_sha256"];files[s["path"]]=b
for f in p["files"]:
    b=files[f["path"]];assert h(b)==f["before"]["sha256"]
    assert b==Path(f["before"]["frozen_path"]).read_bytes()
    assert b==subprocess.check_output(["git","show",report["baseline"]+":"+f["path"]],cwd=root)
for s in p["seams"]:
    b=files[s["path"]];v=s["insert_utf8_lf"].encode();at=s["offset"]
    assert h(b)==s["before_step_sha256"];b=b[:at]+v+b[at:]
    assert h(b)==s["after_step_sha256"];files[s["path"]]=b
for f in p["files"]:assert h(files[f["path"]])==f["after"]["sha256"]
print("2 insertion seams; both complete raw/Git/frozen inverses and forward images exact")
